Priority Support: Receive help and answers to your questions

tiers.name: Guidance
tiers.description:
Choose this tier if you want help shaping or refining your story into a clear foundation.

You’ll receive feedback on your premise, blurb, or synopsis, along with guidance on your story direction and how to use Plotlyst effectively for your writing process.

This tier focuses on high-level story development, helping you turn your ideas into a structured foundation.
